Bug_Title: Synchronization should not be done on instances of value-based classes
Bug_Explanation: Synchronization should not be done on instances of value-based classes such as Integer in this case. The JVM caches the value of the instances and will not create new instances for the same value. This can lead to multiple references and hence the synchronization will not work as expected.
Trigger_Explanation: In the method `showBug`, the synchronization is done on the instances of value-based classes `a` and `b`. Since these are final and immutable, the JVM caches them and hence the synchronization will not work as expected.
